name: Haya Herbal Beauty Cream 30gm | Brightening & Glow Formula for Radiant Skin
description:
Haya Beauty Cream is a gentle formula enriched with natural ingredients to enhance skin brightness and restore a healthy glow. Its lightweight texture absorbs quickly, reducing dullness and improving uneven skin tone for a fresh, radiant complexion. Suitable for everyday use, it hydrates the skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and nourished. Free from greasiness, it feels comfortable and works effectively on all skin types.
Key Features
 Revives dull skin and enhances natural glow
 Evens skin tone and reduces marks or pigmentation
 Lightweight, quick-absorbing, non-greasy formula
 Suitable for daily use on all skin types
 Provides essential hydration for soft, smooth skin
 30gm pack, compact and convenient
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to clean face and neck
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use daily for best results
Material
Natural extracts and moisturizing agents
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs

 1 × 30gm Haya Beauty Cream
